gloss: crying for joy; tears of happiness

definitions.gloss: crying for joy; tears of happiness
definitions.explanation: Shedding tears out of happiness, relief, or deep emotion rather than sadness. A compound of 嬉しい (happy) and 泣き (crying).

examples.japanese: {嬉|うれ}し{泣|な}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}って→知る：00458_shiru⟧{嬉|うれ}し{泣|な}き⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I cried for joy when I found out I had passed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧、{嬉|うれ}し{泣|な}き⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The players were crying tears of joy the moment the championship was decided.

notes:
{嬉|うれ}し{泣|な}き means crying from happiness or overwhelming joy.

FORMS:
⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧ (happy) + {泣|な}き (crying, noun form of ⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {嬉|うれ}し{泣|な}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ / {嬉|うれ}し{泣|な}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cry for joy
- {嬉|うれ}し{泣|な}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧: tears of joy

TYPICAL SITUATIONS:
- Winning a competition (⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧)
- Passing an exam (⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧)
- Being reunited with someone
- Receiving unexpected good news

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {悔|くや}し{泣|な}き: crying out of frustration or regret
- ⟦{泣|な}き{笑|わら}い→泣き笑い：08461_nakiwarai⟧: laughing through tears
